name: agent-builder-drops-optional-coordinator
body:
`opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` is the distributed `agent-builder` agent template (product source embedded into the apg binary via `include_str!` and installed by `apg init` into `~/.config/opencode/agents/`). It offers and generates the agent roster the suite supports, and the roster holds implementers only: the core/root implementer, per-subsystem `<name>-implementers`, and tiered test-implementers where a test tier is file-separable. The template carries zero optional coordinator: its frontmatter `description:` names the implementer roster alone; its roster intro names the generated set as implementers only; its body carries zero coordinator section; its workflow interview carries zero whether-a-coordinator-is-wanted bullet; its default plan names the implementers alone; its scaffold line reads `mode: subagent` unconditionally; and its generated-names allowlist rule carries the implementer examples alone.

The coordinator targeted here is the OPTIONAL GENERATED PRIMARY AGENT, distinct from the coordinator ROLE the `codebase-navigator` performs in the feedback-routing / task-cadence prose. Every use of the word coordinator for that role refers to the navigator role.

Acceptance criteria:
- `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` contains zero offer or generation of an optional coordinator agent: zero coordinator section, zero whether-a-coordinator-is-wanted interview bullet, zero primary-mode scaffold branch, and zero coordinator example in the generated-names allowlist rule.
- Every generated agent is scaffolded `mode: subagent`.
- Scope is the one product-source file; the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are consumer artifacts and are untouched. Zero binary change.
- Scope is the roster and coordinator content; the template's permission-shape rules, gate rules, and register/verify steps are governed by the other `agent-builder` requirements.
